newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR condemns Rwanda killing of four UN staff.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR condemns Rwanda killing of four UN staff.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency chief strongly condemns the ambush killing of four U.N. human rights staffers in Rwanda on Tuesday, her spokeswoman said.
Pamela OToole also said the refugee agency ordered its 16 expatriate staffers in Rwandas border regions of Cyangugu, Ruhengeri, Gisenyi and Kibuye to evacuate to the capital Kigali.

U.N. human rights spokeswoman Marie Vander Elst said in Kigali that four U.N. employees including a Briton and a Cambodian died in an ambush in Cyangugus Karengera commune, 350 km (200 miles) southwest of Kigali on the Zairean border.
A U.N. driver too was shot and undergoing surgery.
